mapper.select: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, contact, phone, address, is_active FROM customer WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY customer_name

SELECT customer_id, customer_name, contact, phone, address, is_active FROM customer
(customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR contact LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND is_active = #{searchActive}
ORDER BY customer_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (customer_name, contact, phone, address, is_active) VALUES (#{customerName}, #{contact}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET customer_name = #{customerName}, contact = #{contact}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
UPDATE customer SET is_active = 0 WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.select:
SELECT '결재문서' AS tradeType, d.doc_type AS docType, d.doc_no AS docNo, d.title AS title, d.status AS status, CASE d.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '기안중' WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '결재완료' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '반려' ELSE d.status END AS statusLabel, DATE_FORMAT(d.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS tradeDate, m.name AS requesterName, d.doc_id AS refId FROM approval_doc d LEFT JOIN member m ON d.requester_id = m.member_id WHERE d.customer_id = #{customerId} AND d.doc_type = 'OUTBOUND'
UNION ALL
SELECT '수주' AS tradeType, 'SALES_ORDER' AS docType, s.so_no AS docNo, CONCAT('수주 ', s.so_no) AS title, s.status AS status, CASE s.status WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN '초안' WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN '확정' WHEN 'PICKING' THEN '피킹중' WHEN 'SHIPPED' THEN '출하완료' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '취소' ELSE s.status END AS statusLabel, DATE_FORMAT(s.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS tradeDate, m.name AS requesterName, s.so_id AS refId FROM sales_order s LEFT JOIN member m ON s.created_by = m.member_id WHERE s.customer_id = #{customerId}
ORDER BY tradeDate DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT doc_id FROM approval_doc WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND doc_type = 'OUTBOUND' UNION ALL SELECT so_id FROM sales_order WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ) t
